fields.def: be in front of, precede, lead
be at rest, at ease, enjoy life of plenty
twist a rope of two strands
congeal, become solid; be hard, stern
go on foot, step by step, walk
Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol
thing to be protected, thing sacred, inviolable
lash with the tail, move spear up and down, shake, quiver
and they snatched it from him
run right and left, run swiftly
and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction
contract the face, look hard, stern
and thou shalt pitch it with pitch
furnish with a rim, enclose, set
the stroke of his battering ram
strike, beat, extend by beating, shape iron into a helmet
fill a pot with rich broth
that with which one is covered
a spreading his cloud upon it
the god speaks and he lives
the revolters are gone deep in slaughtering
the Rock which begat thee thou forgattest
